title: helianthemum canum f. alpinum
intro: Helianthemum canum f. alpinum, commonly known as the alpine rockrose, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Cistaceae. It is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia, and is prized for its ornamental value due to its showy pink flowers. The alpine rockrose has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues, due to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory activity, and antimicrobial effects.
